properties.title: Path of totality (the band)
properties.description: The full corridor swept by the Moon's umbra — its northern and southern limits, from NASA / Espenak ephemeris (17:20–18:32 UT). Only inside this band is the eclipse total; a step outside it and the Sun is only partly covered.

properties.title: Path of totality (centerline)
properties.description: The centerline of the Moon's umbral shadow, traced from NASA / Espenak ephemeris (central line at 2-minute intervals, 17:20–18:32 UT), from the high Arctic down across the North Atlantic — passing just west of Iceland — to landfall in northern Spain and out over the Balearic Sea.

properties.title: Point of greatest eclipse
properties.description: In the North Atlantic west of Iceland (65°10′N, 25°12′W, at 17:46 UT). Here totality reaches its maximum of 2 minutes 18 seconds; everywhere on land it is shorter.

properties.title: Ólafsvík, Iceland
properties.description: On the Snæfellsnes peninsula, near the longest totality on Icelandic land. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Ísafjörður, Iceland
properties.description: The main town of Iceland's Westfjords, inside the path of totality. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: A Coruña, Spain
properties.description: In Galicia, near where the shadow makes landfall in Spain around 20:26 local time, with the Sun very low in the west. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Oviedo, Spain
properties.description: Northern interior, well inside the path of totality. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: León, Spain
properties.description: Inland Castile-and-León, inside the path. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Burgos, Spain
properties.description: Northern interior, inside the path of totality. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Valladolid, Spain
properties.description: Interior Castile, inside the path. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Zaragoza, Spain
properties.description: Northeast interior, inside the path of totality. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Valencia, Spain
properties.description: On the Mediterranean coast; totality here around 20:32 local time, with the Sun near the horizon. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Palma de Mallorca, Spain
properties.description: In the Balearic Islands, inside the path of totality. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Reykjavík, Iceland
properties.description: Iceland's capital lies inside the path but close to its boundary, so totality is brief. The centerline misses Icelandic land entirely. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Bilbao, Spain
properties.description: Sits right on the southern edge of the path, so totality lasts only seconds. A few kilometres out and it would be a partial. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Madrid — misses totality
properties.description: Spain's capital lies just outside the path. A 99.9% partial is not “almost totality”: the Sun is never fully covered, it does not go dark, and the corona never appears. Coordinate approximate — verify.

properties.title: Barcelona — misses totality
properties.description: Also just outside the path of totality, at 99.9% partial. So close, and still on the wrong side of the line. Coordinate approximate — verify.
